== Summary ==
Slip “•Baylan Skoll” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 351, 581, 1074)). Version [[Baylan Skoll]] (Original). Not a recreation.
